rounds.text: Srivari Spices & Foods Ltd trades at a highly attractive P/E of 13.4x [E1], which represents a severe discount against the broader sector benchmark P/E of 35.59x [E6]. This valuation disconnect exists despite stellar historical growth, highlighted by a compounded sales growth rate of 72% over 5 years [E12] and a compounded profit growth rate of 115% over the same period [E15]. The company converts its operations into elite returns, generating an impressive ROE of 24.3% [E11] and an ROCE of 29.2% [E10], both of which drastically outperform sector medians of 9.23% [E8] and 10.2% [E63] respectively. Furthermore, a quantitative discounted cash flow model calculates an intrinsic value of Rs 763 per share compared to the current market price of Rs 254 [E37], establishing a massive margin of safety of 66.7% [E38]. Market participation confirms this high-conviction profile, as evidenced by a rules-based screen scoring 96 out of 100 [E53], a relative-strength rating of 100 against the Nifty 500 [E43], and positive institutional money flow [E36]. Conceded: operating cash flow is negative at Rs -14 Cr in Mar 2026 resulting in a weak cash conversion of -0.88x [E26, E27].
